participants, sessions, scans and phenotype tables as one fact kind with dictionary entries.
Done when: a query combining BOLD, EEG and a questionnaire score returns a frozen selection.

Source: docs/build-plan.md, section 8, package 8.

Architecture assessment, 18 November 2026

PRO04 owns the shared table/dictionary implementation and its cross-study acceptance fixture. Its file-based contract can close independently. D08 retains its original broader scope, including the optional-source adapter for later scheduling. The adapter is outside EP11–EP14 acceptance.
